summary: Replace the encryption secrets with values from `secrets.yml` using `oc set data` on `aap-controller-secret-key` (`secret_key`), `aap-db-fields-encryption-secret` (gateway key) and `aap-hub-db-fields-encryption` (`database_fields.symmetric.key`), delete the temp Postgres and PVC, then scale the gateway and controller Operators back to 1 and follow the gateway Operator logs.
questions: How do I replace the controller secret key on OpenShift?
Which secrets hold AAP encryption keys on OpenShift?

answer_card.title: Replace secrets and scale operators up
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc set data secret/aap-controller-secret-key secret_key="<controller_secret_key>"
oc set data secret/aap-db-fields-encryption-secret secret_key="<gateway_secret_key>"
oc set data secret/aap-hub-db-fields-encryption database_fields.symmetric.key="<hub_db_fields_encryption_key>"
oc delete -f aap-temp-postgres.yaml
oc delete -f aap-temp-pvc.yaml
oc scale --replicas=1 deployment aap-gateway-operator-controller-manager automation-controller-operator-controller-manager
oc logs -f $(oc get pods --no-headers -o custom-columns=":metadata.name" | grep aap-gateway-operator)
```
Values are unencoded.
